name: StudyFilm
description:
Three pieces: a desktop recorder, a vision pipeline, and a web app for parents and guides. The desktop app records what students do while they learn, plus webcam and microphone during tests.

Vision LLMs analyze short windows of each session to find wasted time, write coaching tips and flag possible cheating. Every change is measured against a human-annotated data set. One input change cut false positives on our hardest cases by 27 points. I presented the lessons at Compass AI 2026.

images.description: App launcher interface displaying tiles for multiple learning platforms (AlphaMath Fluency with fact grid tracker, Athena, Duolingo, Math Academy, TeachTales, TrashCat) with preview screenshots of each app's content.

Waste Dashboard analytics showing 'No Waste' time (4hr 9m) vs 'Wasted Time' (2hr 23m, 58%), identifying biggest waste type as 'L4: On-Device Distractions' with detailed bar chart breakdown across multiple days.

outcome: Records millions of study sessions a quarter for thousands of Alpha School students. Vision models turn them into coaching for students, parents and guides.
